heading: **25 October 2025**
body:
### 1. qPCR trial for SELEX samples

qPCR

| qPCR Plates |  |  |  |
| ----- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Reagents | per well in 384 | per 384-well plate | for 6 plates (x440) |
| NF water | 2.91 μL | 1.12 mL | 7.68 mL |
| 5x Phusion HF buffer | 1.25 μL | 480 μL | 3.3 mL |
| 10mM e dNTP | 0.25 μL | 96 μL | 660 μL |
| Primer KingsizeFw2 100μM | 0.025 μL | 9.6 μL | 66 μL |
| Primer KingsizeRev 100μM | 0.025 μL | 9.6 μL | 66 μL |
| MgCl2 (50mM) | 0.0325 μL | 12.48 μL | 85.8 μL |
| Hot Start Phusion DNA Pol | 0.0375 μL | 14.4 μL | 99 μL |
| 100x SYBR (final 1:200) | 0.06 μL | 23.04 μL | 158.4 μL |
| Total | 4.59 μL | 1.765 mL | 12.1155 mL |

To prepare 100x SYBR Green: add 5μL 10,000x SYBR Green into 500μL DMSO, which can be found in Phusion DNA Pol kits. Avoid light.  
Manually load 122μL mix into each well of a 96-well plate (AB0765), then transfer 4.5μL/well into 6x 384-well plates (LightCycler 384).  
Seal the plates to avoid light. Freeze at \-20℃ until use.

This uses 10 uL of reaction volume per well.

Prepare a master-mix for 20 samples ⇒ 200 uL

| 2X Phusion Master Mix | 100 uL |
| :---: | :---: |
| NCAP\_F 10 uM | 30 uL |
| NCAP\_R 10 uM | 30 uL |
| 100X SYBR | 7.2 uL |
| NF Water | 2.8 uL |

Add 8.5 uL of the mix per well for 20 wells of a reaction plate. Add 1.5 uL of a C3/C4 NCAP-SELEX plate (20 wells) into each well.

Run the following program:

| 95°C | 3 min | No acquisition |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 95°C | 10 s | No acquisition |
| 60°C | 20 s       45X | No acquisition |
| 72°C | 1 s | Single acquisition |
| 95°C | 5 s | No acquisition |
| 65°C | 1 min | No acquisition |
| 97°C | 10 acquisitions/°C | Continuous acquisition |
| 40°C | 10 s | No acquisition |

### 2. Quantification  of lig147 PCR2 product

lig147 PCR2: 19.9 ng/uL

### 3. Nucleosome reconstitution

Combine D4 samples into single tube ⇒ D4recon

D5recon

Run Qubit quantification for both these samples.

D4recon: 27.8 ng/uL

D5recon: 37 ng/uL

*NOTE: While moving the samples from the post salt exchange dialysis columns, mistakenly \~10 uL of refolding buffer instead of Nucleosome Buffer C was added to the final sample. This will probably shift the salt concentration of the sample slightly.*

Set up salt exchange dialysis with nucleosome buffer C for replicate of D5recon & D6recon.

### 4. Ligation L10 reaction purification

The ligation reaction L10 was purified with AmpureXP beads and the concentration of the final sample was measured with Qubit:

L10: 35.4 ng/uL
